info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Equipment Administration API
info.description: The Equipment Administration API facilitates the management of facilities and their related equipment within a banking context. This endpoint allows users to retrieve comprehensive details about available equipment, including specifications, status, and allocation. Typical consumers of this API include banking operations staff and facility managers who need to effectively oversee asset utilization and maintenance. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their equipment oversight, streamline operations, and ensure optimal performance of facilities.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details related to the administration of equipment within facilities. It provides important information necessary for managing and maintaining equipment effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized for the retrieval of equipment administration data within the facilities context. It contains the necessary parameters for executing a GET request, ensuring that the appropriate data is fetched based on the specified criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the equipment administration data.

GetEquipmentAdministrationRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operation related to equipment administration in facilities.

GetEquipmentAdministrationResponse_200.title: Facilities Equipment Administration Response

items.description: A list of equipment items associated with facilities.

sort.description: The sort order applied to the items.

GetEquipmentAdministrationResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on facilities equipment administration, providing a list of equipment items along with pagination and sorting details.

EquipmentItem.title: Equipment Item

workOrderId.description: Unique identifier for the work order.

vendorId.description: Unique identifier for the vendor responsible for maintenance.

facilityZone.description: The zone of the facility where the equipment is located.

maintenanceType.description: Type of maintenance planned for the equipment.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Estimated duration of maintenance in minutes.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the equipment record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the equipment record in ISO 8601 format.

EquipmentItem.description: Schema representing a single equipment item associated with a facility.
